wa_mount_cameron_standard.notes: Searched and not usable: SummitPost (403 in Chrome, skipped for the run); The Mountaineers (no Mount Cameron page); WTA gives trail segments only (Cameron Pass trail 3.3 mi one way, 2,401 ft), and summing them would be our own arithmetic; Backcountry Post and a WTA trip report stop at Cameron Basin. Other Peakbagger logs start from camps (2025-07-05, 2013-09-09, 2020-08-08) and do not describe the trailhead-to-summit walk. Peak facts on the Peakbagger peak page: summit 7,194.5 ft (West Peak, NAVD88), East Peak 7,163 ft, Middle Peak 7,120 ft, prominence 1,023 ft. loss_ft (6800) left as it stands: it is the sum of the stored itinerary's daily gains, a different convention.
